scope: Implement hardware-neutral live reservation/admission over physical pools: atomically admit one exact runtime manifest against current runtime observations and owner policy, issue bounded local leases, recheck at launch, and deterministically release without treating observations as reservations.
completion_condition: Atomic local physical-pool lease/admission code, launch-time recheck, deterministic release, portable concurrency/aliasing tests, documentation and validation ledger are committed; CI result is recorded if available.
next_step: Extend the local lease primitive behind a secure enrolled host agent so node-owner policy remains authoritative across machines; then add authenticated private transport before any whole-block executable adapter.
instructions: Completed as an in-process hardware-neutral lease primitive. Admission snapshots explicitly identify which active leases are already reflected in telemetry to avoid double subtraction. No distributed lock, remote reservation, GPU qualification, model correctness or executable distributed-inference claim is made.
